title.zh: Wall Street gains direct oversight of Web3 security as S&P Global buys OpenZeppelin
title.en: Wall Street gains direct oversight of Web3 security as S&P Global buys OpenZeppelin

current_state.zh: S&P Global has agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin, bringing the widely used Web3 security provider under the umbrella of the ratings agency group while preserving its name, leadership, and open-source commitments.
current_state.en: S&P Global has agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin, bringing the widely used Web3 security provider under the umbrella of the ratings agency group while preserving its name, leadership, and open-source commitments.
